title: shadow the resource packhog
description: a resource pack where shadow the hedgehog replaces ever villager
body:
### Description
Step into a darker, more thrilling Minecraft experience with the **Shadow the Resource Packhog** resource pack! This work-in-progress pack brings the edgy anti-hero from the Sonic universe straight into your Minecraft world, replacing every villager and zombie villager with Shadow the Hedgehog.

---

### Features
- **Villagers Transformed:** All villagers have been replaced with Shadow the Hedgehog, bringing his iconic look and attitude to your villages.
- **Zombie Villagers Reimagined:** Zombie villagers are now green-tinted versions of Shadow the Hedgehog, adding a unique twist to your encounters with these corrupted beings.
- **Custom Textures:** Detailed, high-quality textures capture Shadow's unique design, from his red-striped quills to his iconic hover shoes.
- **Immersive Experience:** Enjoy the blend of the Minecraft world with the Shadow the Hedgehog universe, creating a unique and engaging gameplay experience.

---

### Requirements
- **Fabric Mod Loader:** To use the custom models for villagers and zombie villagers, you will need the Fabric mod loader along with the **Entity Model Features (EMF)** and **Entity Texture Features (ETF)** mods.
- **Forge + OptiFine:** Alternatively, for those using Forge, make sure you have OptiFine installed to ensure compatibility with the custom models and textures.

---


Get ready to embrace the darkness and transform your Minecraft world with the power of Shadow the Hedgehog!
![shadow hed hog in a n box whith shadow the headhog bot evil zomibie ghree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ff5c4a6bd133183a268553d3bfebd9b645e76a6.png)

*Note: This is a work-in-progress resource pack, and some features may change or improve over time. Your feedback is valuable in helping me shape the best possible experience.*
